regions.0: the whole scene: gradients, palettes and the present pass
regions.1: the present pass alone: one full-screen triangle through presentPS

ablate_present.equivalence: none: diagnostic, the image is deliberately wrong
ablate_present.expectation: the sRGB, Rec.2020 and ST.2084 conversions gone; the two fetches kept

preregistered_criteria.provenance: every build is gated on the preregistered SHA-256 of every shader the project compiles; the pristine sources are restored on every exit path
preregistered_criteria.correctness: the sample's own render target after a fixed frame count, compared byte for byte against the baseline's. Baseline vs baseline must be identical first or nothing is judged against it
preregistered_criteria.performance: median of the primary timestamp region, several independent processes, counterbalanced order, paired against base
preregistered_criteria.acceptance: median <= -max(1 %, 3 x N95) from this workload's own A/A control, every paired process negative, and correctness passing
